name: Comb & Scissors
headline: COMB & SCISSORS GENTS SALON.​ WHERE STYLE BEGINS.
lede: World-class gents salon IN UAE COMB & Scissors Gents salon.​ Where Style begins. If You Keep Walking Past the Barbers, Eventually You'll Get a Haircut.
about: Our skilled and professional team is dedicated to delivering exceptional service with attention to detail, ensuring every client leaves feeling refreshed, confident, and well taken care of. At our salon, customer satisfaction is at the core of everything we do. Whether you’re here for a quick touch-up or a full grooming session, you’ll be greeted with a warm smile and treated with the highest level of hospitality.

Since 2005, our Gents Salon in the heart of Dubai has been a trusted destination for men seeking top-quality grooming services in a relaxing and welcoming environment. With nearly two decades of experience, we pride ourselves on offering a full range of grooming solutions tailored exclusively for men — from precision haircuts, beard trimming, and classic shaves to manicures, pedicures, facials, and more.
